page.overview:
Who is Cameron Solomon?

Cameron Solomon is an infernal. He is played by Ashley Johnson.

Cameron is described as extremely handsome and hot.

Cameron has recently become more quiet and reserved.

Cameron is the all-star quarterback for the Cinderbrush football team and used to be a straight A student, until an incident that happened last summer that forever changed him. This combined with his recent breakup with Sasha Murasaki has sent him into a slump and caused him to let his grades slip and distance himself from the team.
